trigger: Leave the hospital at dusk (tallman_glimpse, east ridge). Wraith stops.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Dusk. The asphalt still breathes heat. Dust hangs in the last light. The ridge to the east is a black line on orange.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Stops dead. Stares east. A thin, rising whine you've never heard from her.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: On the ridge: a shape. Upright. Too thin. Too still.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You blink. The ridge is empty.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [She won't look away. Her hackles stay up all the way to the bridge.]

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [She follows, but walks backwards for ten steps, watching the ridge.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A coyote, probably. A guy on a hike, probably. You don't mention it to Carly.
